source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, General Information and Lubrication, p.0-11

procedures.title: Crankcase ventilation valve: service
steps: Replace the valve every 12,000 miles or 12 months.
At the same time, clean the hoses, fittings and flame arrestor.
At each oil change, test the system and service it if needed.
notes: Do this more often in prolonged dusty conditions.

procedures.title: Air Injection Reactor (A.I.R.): service
steps: Every 12 months or 12,000 miles, whichever is first, service the A.I.R. pump filter.
At the same interval, check the drive belt for wear and tension.
Keep idle speed, ignition timing and idle mixture at specification; tune up periodically.

procedures.title: Air cleaner: service
steps: Polyurethane element: every 12,000 miles, wash in solvent, squeeze dry, soak in engine oil, then squeeze out the surplus.
Oil-wetted paper element: at the first 12,000 miles, look for dust leaks, holes or damage and replace if found.
If the paper element is good, turn it 180° from its original position.
Replace the paper element at 24,000 miles.
Never wash, oil, tap or blow out a paper element with air.
If fitted, replace the Bow-Tie filter every 24,000 miles.
notes: Service more often in prolonged dusty conditions.

procedures.title: Battery terminal felt washers: lubricate
steps: Every 6,000 miles, soak the felt washers under the battery cable connections with engine oil.
notes: The washers sit between the case top and the cable ends to limit acid corrosion.

procedures.title: Distributor cam lubricator: service
steps: 8-cylinder: every 12,000 miles, turn the cam lubricator end for end.
Replace it every 24,000 miles.

procedures.title: Rear axle and manual transmission: lubricant
steps: Check the lubricant level in the axle and transmission every 6,000 miles.
Top up with the same kind of lubricant already in the housing.
Check with the unit at operating temperature: level should reach the bottom of the filler plug hole.
If the unit is cold, the level should be 1/2 inch below the filler plug hole.

specs.value: SAE 80 viscosity grade may be used

notes: Never use straight mineral oil gear lubricant in a hypoid axle.
Positraction axles must get the special Positraction lubricant.
The rear axle lubricant is not changed for the life of the car; use the lubricants above when refilling after repairs.

procedures.title: Powerglide transmission: fluid check and change
steps: Every 6,000 miles, check fluid on the dipstick with the engine idling, lever in neutral, parking brake on and transmission hot.
If below the full mark, add a small amount of automatic transmission fluid, recheck, and repeat until full.
Do not overfill.
At the first fluid change, adjust the low band (see Section 7).

specs.value: General Motors DEXRON Automatic Transmission Fluid, Part numbers 1050568, 69, 70
